name: CapstonAI – AI SEO & GEO Optimizer for WordPress
author: Greg

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin or install it via the official WordPress repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure options from the CapstonAI menu in your admin panel.
sections.faq:
Does CapstonAI overwrite my content?

No, CapstonAI provides suggestions. You always have full control over your content.
sections.changelog:

  • Added support for full batch processing
  • Improved image conversion backup system
  • Minor bug fixes and UI enhancements

1.0.0

  • Initial Freemium plugin release with SEO
sections.description:
AI-powered SEO and GEO for titles, descriptions, keywords, and alt text. Batch workflows, clear dashboard, WebP optimization. You stay in control.

**CapstonAI: SEO built for the LLM era**

CapstonAI unifies SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) so your site is discoverable in both classic search and AI answers. It audits each URL, then proposes optimized meta titles, meta descriptions, keywords, and alt text you can approve in one click or refine before publish. For large catalogs, run bulk operations with live progress and per-item review.

Why CapstonAI outperforms
– Structured relevance: cleaner, intent-matched metadata that improves CTR in SERPs and increases the likelihood of being cited by LLMs.
– Page speed signals: WebP conversion and compression support Core Web Vitals and efficient crawling.
– Editor-first control: suggestions, never silent overwrites.

Feature highlights
– Context-aware AI for titles, descriptions, keywords, and alt text
– Batch analysis with progress feedback and bulk approval
– Image optimization to reduce weight and stabilize UX metrics
– Works alongside Yoast, Rank Math, or AIOSEO; keep your stack, add AI meta and bulk speed
– Clean dashboard to track actions, status, and results

GEO in practice
– Consistent, explicit metadata improves retrieval quality in LLMs and generative search surfaces.
– Faster, lighter pages are easier for crawlers and models to ingest.
– Human-in-the-loop ensures scalable quality across hundreds of URLs.

Architecture & privacy
– Lightweight: no front-end CSS/JS payloads added by the plugin
– Secure admin-side HTTPS calls only, to https://api-test.capston.ai/
– No extra account or API key beyond activation

Learn more
– Website: CapstonAI

Who it’s for

  • Content-heavy WordPress sites that need scalable on-page SEO across posts, pages, and custom post types
  • Ecommerce and marketplace catalogs that require fast, consistent metadata at scale
  • News, media, and documentation hubs aiming for high snippet CTR and stable coverage
  • Local and multi-location brands targeting stronger local SEO with clean, consistent metadata
  • Agencies, integrators, and hosting providers managing multiple WordPress installs

External services

This plugin connects to the external service CapstonAI API (https://capston.ai) in order to provide SEO analysis and optimization features.

When using the plugin, the following data may be transmitted to the CapstonAI API:
– Page metadata (titles and descriptions) when generating or updating SEO suggestions.
– Website information (site URL, page URL and plugin identifier) for license validation and subscription checks.

All requests are sent securely via HTTPS to the domain:
https://api-test.capston.ai/

This data exchange is required for the plugin to function correctly (e.g., generating SEO suggestions, validating customer actions, or updating metadata).

Service provider: CapstonAI (https://capston.ai)
Terms of Service: https://capston.ai/ai-terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://capston.ai/privacy-policy/
